nbis.headline: [NEW] NBIS Wed close $141.52 (−6.67%), open/high/low $145.81/$152.88/$140.02, vol ~19.2M, cap $38.47B; post-market $137.54 (−2.81%) at 19:59 ET
nbis.why: Gives back Tue's +7.3% bounce and then some; sold while Nasdaq +1.4%. Still ~53% below 52-wk high $299.86. No company filing.

nbis.headline: [NEW] Driver: Democratic midterm sweep → data-center moratorium fears. Texas gov-elect Hinojosa campaigned on an immediate pause; Wells Fargo puts Texas at ~27% of planned US DC GW. NBIS has no disclosed Texas site (NJ/MO/PA)
nbis.why: Sector selloff in neoclouds/power/contractors (IREN/HUT/CRWV weak). NBIS is trading the political risk, not a Texas asset hit.

nbis.headline: [NEW] Citi cut NBIS PT $324→$265, kept Buy, ahead of Q3; focus stays on financing
nbis.why: Lower bar, not a thesis break. Street still wants the Dec ARR path ($7–9B guide) on 12 Nov.

nbis.headline: [NEW] Local ballots: voters sided against data centers in 40 of 41 measures across 10 states (Ballotpedia/CNBC); lone miss Harwood ND
nbis.why: Political risk is national, not just Texas. Broadens the permitting-delay narrative for neoclouds.

nbis.headline: Q3 2026 results Thu 12 Nov before open, call 8:00 ET (20:00 ICT). No NBIS SEC filing found 3–5 Nov (EDGAR full-text search 0 hits)
nbis.why: Funding mix, prepayments, MSFT/META ramp and ARR trajectory matter more than the election print.
